title: Implement Configurable Session Timeout
description: The ChromaticCanvas Control Center is a web dashboard for managing digital art installations. A recent security audit recommended that the user session timeout, which is currently hardcoded, should be made configurable. This task involves updating the application to read the timeout value from a configuration file, applying it to the session management logic, and adding a test to verify the new behavior. The work will be split across three distinct development sessions.

project_spec.name: ChromaticCanvas Control Center
project_spec.description:
ChromaticCanvas Control Center is an advanced, component-driven web dashboard written entirely in Rust that empowers visual artists, design studios, and interactive agencies to orchestrate their creative assets, live project data, and client interactions from a single, secure hub. Every tile, graph, or widget on the dashboard is treated as a self-contained “color swatch” component that can be remixed, themed, or replaced at runtime, reflecting the way a creative professional layers strokes on an actual canvas.    

Built for hard-level complexity, the system weaves together a RESTful service layer, an MVC-inspired UI renderer, and a rich palette of middleware components—authentication, payment processing, search, caching, and real-time notifications—each mounted into the dashboard like modular art supplies. The project highlights creative workflows: drag-and-drop file uploads for artwork, AI-driven color-scheme suggestions, time-lapse render replays, and revenue analytics for commissioned pieces, all while enforcing strict data validation, session management, SSL security, and robust error handling. Because every capability is encapsulated as a reusable component, studios can curate bespoke dashboards for different clients (e.g., motion graphics vs. illustration) without touching the core framework.    

The visual front-end is rendered with Yew and Tailwind-inspired styling, providing a fully responsive layout that feels as fluid on a stylus-driven tablet as on a 5K desktop. A strong logging system, pluggable search index, and email/SMS notification pipeline round out the pro-grade feature set, ensuring ChromaticCanvas scales from a solo creator to a multi-agency enterprise—all while maintaining the elegance and safety guarantees of Rust.
dependencies: tera (server-side templating for SSR fallbacks, MVC view layer)
aws-sdk-s3 or cloud storage crate (file_upload, asset CDN integration)
